script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: The line’s “Moses was buried there” could mean he was buried in Beth-peor itself or in the same valley where Israel stayed. Deuteronomy 34:6 says he was buried in a valley facing Beth-peor.
“Testimonies, statutes, and ordinances” in the second moment is above a 5th-grade reading level. Consider “laws and commands.”
